title: Write a Maintenance Request

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

instructions: Write your own first draft; the fictional example is for study, not your submission.
prompt: Write 120–160 words to a fictional building manager about at least two maintenance concerns. Describe what was checked before, what needs attention now, and when you can meet a worker. Use at least six lesson words and include two passive sentences.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Use four parts: purpose; first concern and previous check; second concern; appointment and polite request. Do not guess the cause of an electrical problem.

reference: Hello Alex, I am writing about two maintenance concerns in the community room. The faucet near the sink is dripping, and the floor below it feels damp. The pipe was inspected last month, but the area needs another check. Could the office arrange a visit on Thursday? I can meet a worker between two and three. I also noticed a loose handle on the cupboard. The hinge may need attention, but I have not tried to tighten the screw myself. A photograph of the damp patch is attached to this message so the worker can compare it later. There is also a cable beside the socket, so I have left it alone and informed the office. Please tell me whether a qualified technician can check it. Thank you for helping us keep the room ready for Saturday.
referenceLabel: 原创示例，仅供学习；不要作为自己的待提交作文。
